import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    a0,a1,a2,a3,c,k,q,b,d,g = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7],params[8],params[9]
    return a0 + a1*T + a2*T**2 + a3/T + c*np.exp(-k*T**q) + b*eps*np.exp(-d*eps)/T + g*eps**2*np.exp(-2*d*eps)/T
